name: benweese
description: Ben Weese's Claude Code plugins: Playwright test automation, docs, repo workflow, guardrails, privacy and accessibility.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Plan, generate, run and heal Playwright API and UI tests in TypeScript.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: /docs sweep (README, CLAUDE.md, JSDoc) and /docs phase N (end-of-phase docs update + PR).

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: /board for GitHub Projects (configured per repo), a lint check, and opt-in session rules.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks committing secrets (on by default); opt-in protected files, destructive-command confirm, lint after edit.

plugins.name: privacy
plugins.description: /privacy-scan, a privacy-reviewer agent and an opt-in commit blocker for personal data.

plugins.name: accessibility
plugins.description: Helps Claude build accessible UI: /a11y (axe scan with plain-English fixes), an a11y-reviewer agent and a contrast calculator.
